name: Issued asset payment
description: Two issued assets share the code TESTUSD but have distinct issuer references. The recipient holds a trustline only to the first issuer, so a payment of the second issuer's TESTUSD must be rejected: a matching asset code is not enough because the issuer identity is part of the asset. The payment must fail with the precise missing-trustline error for the actual second issuer, and the recipient's existing trustline to the first issuer must remain present with its balance unchanged.
